Ottilia has been Ylvie’s partner in crime since they were seven years old, when Ottilia’s family moved in next door and the two girls bonded over their shared love of building elaborate fairy houses in Ottilia’s backyard. From childhood adventures to teenage heartbreaks to navigating adulthood, they’ve been each other’s constant through every major life moment. Throughout high school, Ottilia was the practical one who kept Ylvie grounded when her creative mind got carried away with ambitious art projects that were due the next day. In college, even though they attended different schools, they maintained their friendship through weekly video calls, care packages during finals, and epic summer road trips that always included too much junk food and terrible singing along to pop music.
